newsitem.title: SPAIN: Cantabrico posts 13.9 pct fall in Q1 profit.
newsitem.headline: Cantabrico posts 13.9 pct fall in Q1 profit.

text.p: Spanish electricity firm Hidroelectrico del Cantabrico said on Tuesday its net profit was down 13.9 percent in the first quarter of 1997 to 3.88 billion pesetas versus 4.51 billion pesetas.
The statement added that in general the electricity business was affected by a three percent cut in the tariff, flat consumption and 23 percent less rainfall than during the year-earlier period.
Financial expenditure fell to 1.7 billion pesetas from 2.27 billion pesetas, while net cash flow rose to 8.94 billion pesetas from 8.40.
